entries.81df1d8a31f57d85: Using its drug discovery platform technology 'STEP UP', which uses functional peptide AJP001 as a carrier, it can create antibody-inducing peptides that cause the body to produce antibodies against self-proteins that do not normally trigger antibody production; 3 development products—FPP003, FPP004X and FPP005—have emerged from this technology. Because antibody-inducing peptides are peptides that can be manufactured by chemical synthesis, they are being developed as alternative drugs that keep manufacturing costs low relative to high-priced antibody drugs.
entries.8633e74ad299144a: The Group consists of the company and one consolidated subsidiary, FunPep Healthcare Co., Ltd., and is a single-segment business conducting R&D on functional peptides based on research results from the Graduate School of Medicine, Osaka University. entries.fbbf02748d3b38bd: The company defines its technology domain as the area based on functional peptides and related areas that have synergies with them. Leveraging its drug discovery platform technology as a strength, it will pursue business development centered on pharmaceutical R&D. The group is a drug discovery biotech venture originating from Osaka University, and plays the role of incubating university research results toward bridging them to pharmaceutical companies. The policy is to incubate technology seeds by taking development products from basic research using university technology seeds through to clinical trials at a certain stage and approval applications, depending on the development scale of each product, in order to raise their value. Because pharmaceutical R&D takes a long time and requires large sums of capital, the policy is to establish partnership arrangements with pharmaceutical companies and others from an early stage of R&D, and to advance R&D while reducing the financial risks associated with R&D investment through partnership income and similar revenue during the R&D stage. And if the group's development products are launched in the future, it plans to achieve full-scale revenue growth through royalty income and similar income received from partner pharmaceutical companies.
